string.text: A number haunts me, as if it's chasing me from a previous life. I knew it then, when I didn't believe. I remember it now - 342089. It's the code to a door but I do not remember the way to the door.

Brethren! The infidels managed to shut off the Antennae. All squads, retreat to Pripyat, we must not let them through to the North! I am leaving some ammunition for the retreating squads - in the Rapid-Transit Control section. Use it if running low on ammo, and do your best to slow them down. Code is 1287975. Glory to the Monolith!

バーキープ「知らせを聞いた途端、ここは大騒ぎだ！ 行ける奴はみんなゾーンの中心へ向かった。ローナーも、フリーダムも、デューティーも、マーセナリーズまでな。最初に着いた奴が、すべてを手に入れる！ 願望機、山ほどのアーティファクト、それに何があるか誰にも分からん。急げ。願望機が本当に発電所の石棺にあるなら、一番乗りした奴の望みが全部かなうぞ！ 今、ベテラン部隊がプリピャチの手前に集まっている。急げば同行できるはずだ」

I turned off the Scorcher. For some reason, I lost consciousness just as I did it. Then, I had a dream: I saw again the massive Chernobyl power plant and the sarcophagus. Then a flash. The shining Monolith inside the sarcophagus. I understand that it is the Wish-Granting Machine. A stalker, exhausted and in rags, reaches feebly out to it... a bright flash and I see a fragment of the first dream... A man stands with his back to me and keeps shooting. Someone shouts, "Strelok!". The man shudders, freezes for a moment and then starts to turn slowly... but the pictures slide past, as if a film was played backwards, and I see how he uses his weapon to force the rats back into the station... I realize that I was there. I must go to the Monolith.

I don't know if I was right or not. And I never will know it for sure. But I've made the choice. I hope it was correct. Those mad scientists, who had conducted horrible experiments on humanity and nature for many years, are now gone... My goal has been reached and my journey is over, or so it seems... But I don't believe the Zone will just disappear and the people will stop killing each other for its dubious children - the artifacts. I'm sure there are many more choices for me to make. Yet one thing is for sure, from now on I alone decide my path, and everything I face in the future will depend solely on my own decisions...
